title: Zesty Earthy Japanese Mushroom Onigiri
description: A weeknight Japanese dish featuring earthy mushrooms and genmaicha, shaped into nigiri and low in sodium, perfect for a quick and easy dinner
instructions: Rinse the Japanese rice thoroughly and cook according to the package instructions
Brew the genmaicha tea according to the package instructions and let it cool
In a pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the sliced mushrooms until they are tender
In a large bowl, combine the cooked Japanese rice, brewed genmaicha tea, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and salt, and mix well
Add the sauteed mushrooms and chopped green onions to the rice mixture and mix until they are evenly distributed
Using wet hands, shape the rice mixture into small nigiri shapes
Serve the onigiri warm or at room temperature
Garnish with additional chopped green onions if desired
